description: Source code for the Dashboard component in Apache Superset frontend, managing dashboard rendering, filters, chart updates, and lifecycle events.

classes.name: Dashboard
classes.description: React component class for rendering and managing a dashboard, including lifecycle, filters, and chart updates.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Initializes dashboard, logs mount event, sets up visibility change listener, and applies charts.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Handles updates to layout and chart addition/removal.

methods.name: applyCharts
methods.description: Determines if filters or data have changed and applies necessary updates.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: Cleans up event listeners and resets chart states.

methods.name: onVisibilityChange
methods.description: Logs visibility duration when tab visibility changes.

methods.name: applyFilters
methods.description: Updates affected charts based on filter changes.

methods.name: refreshCharts
methods.description: Triggers queries for specified chart IDs.
